info.name: Winfreight FMS
info.description:
The below information is extremely vital for using almost all Winfreight Endpoints.

| Data | Description |
| --- | --- |
| **API Credentials (Username & Password)** | Retrieved from Winfreight |
| **A BaseURL** | Retrieved from Winfreight |
| **An Account Number** | The Account Number you have with your Winfreight Partner |
| **A GroupName** | A Unique Identifier to be passed with every call. |

- AU**THENTICATION**
    
    - A Token will be generated from the "Get Token" Endpoint using the Credentials provided.  
        This Token is valid for an hour and must be passed as a BEARER TOKEN for all subsequent calls after being generated.
        
- **RATE LIMITING**
    
    - A Maximum of 2000/min per IP for Create Endpoints , and 100/min for Get and Delete Endpoints
        

> _If you exceed the rate limit, you will receive a_ `_429 Too Many Requests_` _error with a_ `_Retry-After_` _header indicating when you can try again._ 
  

#### This below will assist you in utilising the Winfreight API

_It consists of 7 Sections_

- **Getting Started**
    
- **Collections**
    
- **Waybills**
    
- **Tracking**
    
- **POD's**
    
- **Labels**
    

#### **Waybill Creation:**

_Winfreight allows for 2 methods of Waybill Creation_

1. The 1st is for Customers who utilise Winfreight's Track-and-Trace , this utilizes the ["Create Waybill Import Header"](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/20366622/2s9YRFVqR4#7fbd7117-b054-4ff3-98cc-096877c15503) and ["Create Waybill Import Dims & Detail"](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/20366622/2s9YRFVqR4#191c2143-731b-4864-b627-c6f0bfa829b8) and would require an Acceptance Scan to import the Waybill from a Staging table.
    
2. The 2nd is for Customers who do not utilize Track-and-Trace this essentilly creates a waybill directly in the live system utilizing the ["Create Waybill"](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/20366622/2s9YRFVqR4#f3520218-e3dd-4367-8309-b581164a087c) and ["Create Dims" ](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/20366622/2s9YRFVqR4#05d2836d-d4e0-4478-8a59-fa0baf2f0706) Endpoints and does not offer any scanning functionality.
